title: First-run structured response visuals and validation walkthrough
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and produce a compact set of onboarding/quickstart visuals and annotated screenshots that teach users how to provide a JSON schema to the Redwood API, how the Console validates structured output, and how to read validation errors. Focus on short, actionable microcopy and a lightweight validation UI that surfaces errors without blocking generation. Deliverables: 6 annotated screenshots, 3 gif micro-interactions, a copy deck with tooltip content, and a redline handoff for engineering.
goals: Reduce first-run confusion for structured output by showing examples inline
Provide a compact validation UI pattern that can be re-used in Console and docs
Ship assets ready for localization and accessibility review
mockups: Onboarding modal illustrating three schema examples (flat, nested, enum) with one-click paste
Schema playground panel: left editor, center preview, right validation panel showing warnings + fix suggestions
Inline validation banner on run: compact error summary + 'Show details' expansion
Sample response card rendered with mapping from schema keys to generated tokens
Accessibility-focused high-contrast variants and keyboard flows
